title: Before the Code
blurb: Hollywood from 1930 to 1934, before the Production Code was enforced and the studios had to behave. Faster, stranger and more grown-up than the decade that followed.

films.note: A big-game hunter who hunts people, shot at night on the King Kong sets with the same cast. Sixty-three minutes.
The first zombie film. Lugosi, a Haitian sugar mill, a bride who will not stay dead.
John Barrymore as the hypnotist, with sets that lean like Caligari's.
Boris Karloff comes home to England to rise from the tomb. Thought lost for decades.
Leslie Howard saves aristocrats from the guillotine while pretending to be a fop.
Dolores del Río, a South Seas island, and a swim the Code would have cut.
Gloria Swanson with a past, in a comedy that would not have been made two years later.
William Powell as Philo Vance in a locked-room mystery, directed by Michael Curtiz.
Hemingway, Gary Cooper and Helen Hayes. The ending the studio dared to keep.
Douglas Fairbanks, past forty, bets he can live on a desert island. He built the tree house himself.
